blogs.title: Design That Sells: Principles Behind High-Converting Websites
blogs.excerpt: How intentional layout, hierarchy and pacing turn a beautiful website into a revenue engine.
blogs.content:
## Start with the business goal

A beautiful website that does not convert is a poster. Before a single pixel is drawn, we define what success looks like: a booked call, a downloaded deck, a closed deal.

## Hierarchy is everything

The eye follows a path. We stage information so the most important message lands first, then support it with evidence, proof and one clear call to action.

## Motion with purpose

Micro-interactions and scroll reveals should guide, never distract. Every animation earns its place by explaining the interface.

## Measure and iterate

Launch is just the start. Heatmaps, session recordings and conversion data tell us what to refine next week, not next quarter.

blogs.title: AI Chatbots That Actually Help Your Customers
blogs.excerpt: Rule-based bots frustrate. Here is how we build assistants that resolve, escalate and delight.
blogs.content:
## Why most chatbots fail

Most bots are decision trees pretending to be intelligence. They answer the wrong question confidently and dead-end real customers into a queue.

## Give the bot a knowledge base

Our assistants are grounded in your actual product documentation, policies and past conversations, so answers stay accurate and on-brand.

## Escalate gracefully

A good bot knows its limits. When confidence drops, it hands off to a human with full context, no repeating the story.

## Measure what matters

We track deflection rate, resolution rate and customer effort, not just "messages handled".
